purpose: M2-D robustness, ablation, and generalisation audit: pre-declared spatial-partition matrix and frozen training recipe reference, written before any new test-set inference. This matrix is a robustness study over M2-C's already-locked result; it must never be used to select a new best model, fusion weight, or risk threshold, and must never overwrite M2-C's frozen artifacts.

frozen_reference_result.note: M2-C's own locked spatial-test evaluation. Frozen, read-only, never rerun by M2-D. See src/s3_ecological/experiments/m2c_reference.py for the exact hash/value constants.

frozen_training_recipe.location_encoding: encode_cos_sin: [sin(pi*lon/180), sin(pi*lat/90), cos(pi*lon/180), cos(pi*lat/90)] plus [sin(pi*date), cos(pi*date)] when use_date_feats is true
frozen_training_recipe.hyperparameter_search_status: Already performed once, on the reference partition only, by M2-C. M2-D does not repeat this search for any partition: every new partition trains only this single frozen config_id via train_geo_prior.py --only-config-id filts256_dateTrue.

fusion_note: Fusion uses the existing fixed formula and Prototype Implementation Profile v0.1 constants unmodified (src/s3_ecological/fusion/ is not touched by M2-D). No calibration or learned weights are introduced.

bootstrap.note: Matches M2-C's bootstrap_confidence_interval usage in scripts/evaluate_geo_prior_m2c.py.

ablation.training_status: Already trained by M2-C as part of its own 4-config grid search on the reference train split (same seed). M2-D reuses this checkpoint read-only via src/s3_ecological/experiments/geo_prior_candidate.py; it is NOT retrained.
ablation.note: Same reference spatial-split-manifest and same reference S1 bundle M2-C already validated are reused for this comparison; only the geo_prior config differs, so no new S1 bundle is required for the ablation.

prohibited_conclusions: No open-set, OOD, calibration, potential-incursion, false-alert, or biosecurity-efficacy conclusions without corresponding authorised data and a pre-registered protocol.
Spatial partitions in this matrix are not temporal holdouts and must not be reported as local/non-local OOD splits.
No new best model, fusion weight, or risk threshold selection from these results.
No modification of M2-C's frozen configuration, checkpoint, report, or spatial split identity.
